method: CTC forced alignment on original TTS WAV chunks

cues.text: Our primary outcome is load-state detection.
MCC stands for Matthews correlation coefficient.
For each device, we compare its predicted on and off states with the test labels.
We calculate one MCC score for each device.
For macro MCC, we add the 9 scores and divide by 9.
This test metric is separate from the aggregate-only selection score.
We use test labels only after selection is locked.
